lines.text: On Preparation Day, in the evening, Joseph of Arimathea boldly went to Pilate to ask for the body of Jesus.
Pilate was surprised Jesus was dead, so he summoned the high priest, and then he granted the body to Joseph.
Joseph wrapped the body in linen, laid it in a tomb cut from rock, and rolled a stone against it.
After the Sabbath, the women bought spices, went to the tomb at sunrise, and found the stone rolled away.
A young man in a white robe told the women that Jesus is going ahead of the disciples into Bethany.
